title: お正月と学校行事のフレーム
lead: お正月・成人式・節分・ひな祭りから入学・卒業まで、和風のフレーム12点です。年賀状や式典の案内、掲示物に使えます。
subject_en: Decorative frames/borders with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, landscape or square, thick enough to hold text or a photo, decorated with the motifs of the theme. Japanese traditional style with washi colours and gold accents. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: frame with pine, bamboo, plum and a rising sun
frame of kadomatsu pine decorations and shimenawa
frame with hagoita paddles and shuttlecocks
frame with furisode kimono patterns and flowers
frame with beans, oni masks and holly sardine
frame with peach blossoms and hishi-mochi
frame with cherry blossoms and a red school bag
frame with cherry blossoms, a diploma tube and a ribbon
frame with a hemp-leaf pattern border
frame with a wave pattern border
